quotes.text: I lost my processor twice in one year for the word tarot on a checkout page. The first thing DOGM.AI did wasn't show me AI — it was make sure I could get paid. That's how you earn a reader's trust.
quotes.name: Maren V.
quotes.role: Tarot reader · design partner, cohort I

quotes.text: The Voice drafts sound like me on a good day — my phrasing, my ethics, my refusals. I still write every reading. I just stopped writing every reading twice.
quotes.name: Adaeze O.
quotes.role: Astrologer & coach · design partner, cohort I

quotes.text: My clients ask about AI constantly now. Being able to say “check the seal — a human read this, provably” turned the scariest question in my inbox into my best marketing.
quotes.name: Solène R.
quotes.role: Evolutionary astrologer · design partner, cohort I
